items.name: column-chart
items.title: Column Chart
items.description: Vertical bars for ordered categories — time buckets or ranked categories. Tufte data-ink discipline: one accent, no gridlines, direct value labels by default, negatives first-class below an always-visible zero baseline. Monospace numerics (Hack), pixel-font label badges (Departure Mono), built-in source attribution, reference line (fixed or mean/median), sort + top-N with an honest 'Other' aggregate, native PNG/SVG/CSV export, JSON portability. Zero dependencies beyond React. Built to WCAG 2.2 AA: roving tabindex, ARIA graphics roles, screen-reader data table, forced-colors support.
items.author: Almas Kasymzhanov <almaskasymzhanov@gmail.com>

items.name: bar-chart
items.title: Bar Chart
items.description: Horizontal bars for ranked categories. The ranking shape: sort + top-N with an honest 'Other' aggregate, height derived from the item count, explicit label-column width with a CSS-only truncation policy. Tufte data-ink discipline: one accent, no gridlines, direct value labels by default, negatives first-class growing left of an always-visible zero baseline. Reference line (fixed or mean/median), native PNG/SVG/CSV export, JSON portability. Zero dependencies beyond React. Built to WCAG 2.2 AA: roving tabindex, ARIA graphics roles, screen-reader data table, forced-colors support.
items.author: Almas Kasymzhanov <almaskasymzhanov@gmail.com>

items.name: line-chart
items.title: Line Chart
items.description: Multi-series lines for continuous time-series — change over time, indexed comparisons, forecasts. The FT / John Burn-Murdoch canon: direct line-end labels instead of a legend, one emphasized series in the accent while the rest mute to grey (never a rainbow), faint horizontal gridlines (the deliberate deviation from the no-gridline bar rule), honest gaps where data is missing (y: null breaks the line, never interpolated), a Y domain that reads change not magnitude-from-zero, and editorial layers (event markers, recession-shading bands, dashed forecast lines). Monospace numerics (Hack), built-in source attribution, reference line (fixed or mean/median), crosshair multi-series tooltip, native PNG/SVG/CSV export, JSON portability. Zero dependencies beyond React. Built to WCAG 2.2 AA: roving tabindex, ARIA graphics roles, screen-reader data table, forced-colors support.
items.author: Almas Kasymzhanov <almaskasymzhanov@gmail.com>
